{07 14 00}Palun väga! See on lihtsalt

minu käest, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 19 00}This is just a token of my
appreciation for you,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 14 00}Thanks to you{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.I'm never
gonna be alone again!
